messages:
Sophie: heads-up — spotted gradual KV cache mem growth on qwen-gqa prod host during our 100k token long-context run. looks like lots of tiny free fragments piling up instead of being reused :eyes:
Alex: hmm. is this the usual rope-scaling fragmentation or something new?
Sophie: not the usual. fragmentation pattern has a strong long-tail: many 64-256B free runs, avg fragment size ~120B, but overall free-run count keeps increasing. compaction not firing.
Jia: do we have kernel-switching telemetry for that host? could be MQA/GQA kernel selection dithering and leaving partially-used pages.
Sophie: yes, kernel-selection toggles observed. requests start on gqa-kernel then switch to mqa-optimized path mid-session when seq len drops. suspect per-shard slot layout differs between kernels so reuse fails.
Matt: any repro commands? I can run a long-run in staging with extra logging.
Sophie: quick dump we used (attached):
```
$ runtimed --dump-kv-telemetry --shard 3 --out /tmp/kv.txt
slot_count: 131072
allocated_pages: 10240
free_runs: 8421
avg_fragment_size: 118
last_compact_ts: 0
per_kernel_affinity: {gqa: 0.6, mqa: 0.4}
page_usage_histogram: {1: 3400, 2: 1200, 4: 900, 8: 600, 16: 300, 32: 100}
```
Sophie: note last_compact_ts==0 on this shard — compaction never triggered because compaction heuristic needs >512B avg fragment to be worthwhile. our fragments are small.
Alex: so compaction threshold mismatch: heuristics tuned for large fragments, but rope scaling + mixed kernel yields many small holes.
Jia: can we try two things: 1) lower compaction threshold for long-context workloads; 2) add per-kernel compaction that runs when kernel affinity flips?
Matt: 1) is cheap to toggle in config. i'll flip threshold to 64B on staging and run 6h long-run. 2) per-kernel compaction needs more thought (race with evict scheduler).
Sophie: also seeing higher page alloc churn when batching heuristic switches kernel mid-batch. batching affinity idea: keep same kernel for batched requests that share shard to reduce kernel-induced layout differences.
Alex: good point — batching heuristic currently favors latency and mixes kernels. we can add a "kernel_affinity" hint in batch planner. low-risk patch.
Jia: we should also expand telemetry: track free_run_size_distribution per-kernel and emit a compactness_score metric. that'll let us detect fragmentation early.
Sophie: adding an eval case to our perf harness: 1) qwen-gqa 100k tokens, 2) alternate seq lengths to force kernel switches, 3) collect compactness_score.
Matt: assigned myself to run staging job + config change. will post logs to the thread.
infra-bot: created job infra/long-kv-scan/2026-03-18-01 (staging). status: queued.
Alex: if staging confirms, we should consider an emergency server-side toggle for compaction threshold for affected customers. also add an automated compaction sweep for shards with last_compact_ts==0 after X hours.
Jia: and document kernel-affinity in runtime design doc + a small note in README for operators.
Sophie: thanks — key action items: Matt run + logs, Jia add telemetry/compactness metric, Alex prototype batch planner hint. i'll PR a short repro script for our perf harness.
Matt: rough ETA: logs by EOD.
Sophie: :thumbsup:
Alex: :thinking_face: also flagging this for the next perf retro.
